gloss: to produce; to create; to make (a work)

definitions.gloss: to produce; to create; to make (a creative or media work)
definitions.explanation: To create something through a planned process, especially artistic, media, or creative works such as films, programs, artworks, and games.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}を{制作|せいさく}する。
このアニメは{日本|にほん}の{会社|かいしゃ}が{制作|せいさく}した。
examples.english: This anime was produced by a Japanese company.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}たちが{協力|きょうりょく}して{短編|たんぺん}{映画|えいが}を{制作|せいさく}している。
examples.english: The students are working together to produce a short film.

notes:
{制作|せいさく}する is used for creative and media production — films, TV shows, artworks, games, and advertisements. It implies an organized production process. Note the distinction from the near-homophone {製作|せいさく}する, which focuses on manufacturing physical products.

USAGE:
- ～を{制作|せいさく}する: to produce/create something

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {映画|えいが}を{制作|せいさく}する: to produce a film
- {番組|ばんぐみ}を{制作|せいさく}する: to produce a program
- {作品|さくひん}を{制作|せいさく}する: to create a work
- {制作|せいさく}{費|ひ}: production cost
- {制作|せいさく}{者|しゃ}: producer; creator
- {制作|せいさく}{過程|かてい}: production process

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {製作|せいさく}する: to manufacture; to produce — same pronunciation but uses a different kanji; focuses on making physical goods or industrial products
- {作成|さくせい}する: to create; to prepare — used for documents, plans, and data; more routine and less creative
- {製造|せいぞう}する: to manufacture — industrial mass production of goods
